features: No mandatory 2-sensor threshold for research evidence
Positive signal requires source model mapped to canonical UID, matched sensor/heater, valid scan/I2C/ADS quality and LOD over noise floor
Positive sensor response is only research candidate support; chemical identity and ppm remain unconfirmed
Non-response at unknown field concentration never creates chemical exclusion
Only an independently referenced known-concentration challenge with a source-expected response >=2x detection threshold can record CONDITIONAL_NEGATIVE sensor-model support
Cross-sensitivity and wrong-direction responses abstain/ambiguous; no false identity
scope_limits: Challenge negatives are controlled sensor model evidence, not proof of absence of a chemical already independently known present
Models and independent challenge metadata are synthetic test fixtures
No actual Tank G3 or concentration certification
